content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for TNPL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.tnpl.com. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 23-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TNPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for TNPL Recruitment 2026 is 23rd September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TNPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for various posts including Assistant General Manager (Marketing), Chief Manager (Marketing), Manager (Marketing)/Deputy Manager (Marketing), Deputy Manager (Marketing)/Assistant Manager (Marketing), and Assistant Manager (Secretarial).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for TNPL posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. For marketing roles, a First Class Engineering Degree or Arts/Science/Commerce Degree with First Class MBA (Marketing) or PG Diploma in Marketing Management is required. For Assistant Manager (Secretarial), a Graduate and Associate Member of ICSI is needed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to TNPL jobs?
faq.answer: The age limit for the posts ranges from a minimum of 28 years to a maximum of 55 years, depending on the specific post and category. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for TNPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TNPL Recruitment 2026. This makes the application process more accessible to a wider range of candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs.31100 - 3% - 65350 to Rs.70100 - 3% - 146960 per month, depending on the post. The specific salary for each position is detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TNPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Application Screening and Document Verification. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted based on their applications and then undergo document verification.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the TNPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official TNPL website, fill it out carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.
